Ṛtuketulakṣaṇa
55th in Av. Pariśiṣṭa. Mu7nchen 183 (59). TB. 214 (55). Weber 366 (65).
Pt.. Leipzig, Roman script edn. of Av. Pariśiṣṭas, I. ii. p.. 371-3.

Ṛtukrīḍāviveka
Q. by Lakṣmīdhara in his C. Śrutirañjanī on the Gītagovinda, wrongly noted a. Bharata-śāstragrantha in a BORI. fr. See ABORI. XV. p. 240; BORI. D. XII. 345. p.. 198-9. ABORI. XVIII. p.. 198-9.

Ṛtucaryā
med. B. IV. 220.
--a part of the Sāramañjarī. Dacca 149. S. 4.

Ṛtucaryā
med. by Vāgbhaṭa. Udaipur I. B. 77, 31. Seems to be ch. 3 of Aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya.
--a section in the Bhūpacaryā or Bhūpālavallabha of Sundaradeva, son of Govindadeva. IO. 2704.

Ṛtunārāyaṇa
from the Nārāyaṇabalipaddhati. Oudh XX. 160.

Ṛtunirṇaya
jy. Adyar I. p. 107a. Jey. Pal. Orissa 56 (tantra).

Ṛtupañcāśikā
by Kavi Maṇḍana. Q. by Raghunātha Manohara (1675-1700) in his Kavikaustubha. See Gode, Stud. in Ind. Lit. His.. III. p. 37; JOR. XXVIII. p. 100.

Ṛtumālā
an. C. by Girīśacandra Kaviratna. Pt.. with C. an. Beng. transl. Maimensingh, 1881. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1897, p. 22. [Page031-b]

Ṛtulaharī
by Mohita Kṛṣṇa Mukhopādhyāya. Pt.. Calcutta, 1872. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1897.

Ṛtuvarṇana
kāvya. GD. 1691 (fr.). Granthappura p. 83. no. 1691 (fr.). Evidently a. extr. from a. kāvya.
--TD. 23662-63.

Ṛtuvarṇana
kāvya. in 6 sargas (with C. ?). by Durlabha. Bikaner 2971. Rep. Raj. & C. I. p. 52. Begins with Śarad an. ends with Varṣā.

Ṛtuvarṇana
kāvya. by Bahoraṇa (?) Skt. Col.. Ben. 1897-1901, p. 203 (no. 831) (inc.).

Ṛtuvarṇana
kāvya. by Bhāskarācārya.
--C. Vyākhyā by Vidyākara Miśra. Mithilā III. 18.
--C. a.. ib. 19.

Ṛtuvarṇana
kāvya. by Viśvambhara. Mithilā II. 19.

Ṛtuśānti
dh. different texts. Adyar I. p. 95b. BISM. v.. 133/32. Burnell 136a. CPB. 583-84. Gough p. 34. MD. 18703 (inc.). Pejawar 131 (e). Sri. Dev. 495 (d). TD. 13463. Udaipur II. 14, 75. 214, 13.
--Ṛv. Br.. 7. Bik. 147.
--Ṛv. from Saṁskāranirṇaya. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 19. America 224. IO. 4815. L. 1299. RASB. II. 796. SB. 111.

Ṛtuśānti
dh. prayoga acc. to Śālihotra. MD. 16895. [Page032-a.

Ṛtuśānti
or Rajodarśanaśānti dh. by Kāśī Dīkṣita. RASB. III. 2598.

Ṛtuśānti
dh. by Śaṅkara Bhaṭṭa. IM. 5470.

Ṛtuśāntiprayoga
dh. Adyar. Ānandāśrama 7351 (yājñika). 8066 (yājñika). B. I. 216. Baroda 8394. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras p. 13. MD. 3581 (acc. to Bodh.).
--Āpast. Baroda 7260 (b).
--Baudh. Baroda 2572.
--for Sāmavedins. Baroda 6360.

Ṛtusaṃhāra
kāvya. by Kālidāsa. For views against Kālidāsa's authorship of this, see: Walter, Indica, iii. 6 ff.; Nobel, ZDMG. LXVI, 275 ff.; JRAS. 1913, p.. 401 ff.; Harichand, Kālidāsa, p.. 240 ff.
For views in favour of Kālidāsa's authorship see: JRAS. 1912, p.. 1066 ff.; 1913, p.. 410 ff.; Stenzler, ZDMG. XLIV. 33; Hillebrandt, Kālidāsa, p.. 66 ff.; Macdonell, A History of Skt. Literature, p.. 337-338; Keith, A History of Skt. Literature, p.. 82-84; Sri Aurobindo Kalidasa (Kālidāsa's Seasons), Pondicherry. 1929, 1950.
